name: Woods of Ypres
description:
'''Woods of Ypres''' was a Canadian [[blackened doom metal]] band from [[Windsor, Ontario]]. It was founded in 2002, initially consisting of David Gold, Aaron Palmer, and Brian McManus. Their line-up frequently changed afterward, with over 20 members through its various incarnations, which operated later based out of [[Toronto]] from 2003 to 2007, and [[Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario|Sault Ste. Marie]] from 2008 to 2011. Their only constant member was [[multi-instrumentalist]] and frontman David Gold. The band ended after his death in December 2011, before releasing the album ''[[Woods 5: Grey Skies & Electric Light]]'', which won the 2013 [[Juno Award]] for the [[Juno Award for Metal/Hard Music Album of the Year|Metal/Hard Music Album of the Year]].

The band was popular in the area surrounding Windsor, where they originated. Gold's vocals have been compared to [[Peter Steele]]'s.
